## Findings

### ac-coverage: Missing mixed-case test for lower
The spec requires automated tests for both ACs. test/function.test.mjs only checks the uppercase input 'ABC'; AC2 (mixed-case converts to lowercase) has no test, and the AC checklist shows it neither auto-verified nor flagged for human verification. Add a mixed-case assertion such as assert.equal(lower('AbC'), 'abc').
